I really had no interest in this genre of game before I played. Luckily for me, Terraria showed me that not not all sandbox adventures are Minecraft clones. I played with friends who were a mix of battle hardened veterans, and dirt covered noobs (myself included), but we quickly learned the value of having a group, and enjoyed the experience of constructing a small town with elaborate and unique houses, digging to the center of the earth, being attacked by a wide variety of deadly foes, and ultimately unleashing hell upon our little world.

Playing alone was equally satisfying, as the game offers a wide variety of things to keep yourself occupied with, but I still recommend finding friends to experience Terraria with. The beauty of the sandbox genre is being able to share your creations with others, and Terraria offers hours of just that.

Terraria is one of the best games, like ever. If you just wanna build with no worries, Journey mode can stop enemy spawns and you can peacefully build to your hearts content. If you want a challenge you're sure to find one in Expert/Master Mode. Terraria is peak, it's fun, provides a challenge, best death messages, best communnity, funniest workshop, a GOATED dev team, and some of the best music. You're not limited to anything. Terraria revolves around Exploration, Combat and creating a world. The NPCs have personalities, the lore is rich. No matter how many times you die in game, it's worth the money. If you haven't bought already, get it. I would usually make a memey review but this game deserves a proper one. This game has literally everything imaginable, and for 10 dollars. People have sunk 1000-2000, some even 3000 hours into this game, and I intend to do the same. I suggest you stop reading this and spend your damn money. You will not regret it.

Terraria, an incredible game for those who want to explore and defeat difficult challenges, is personally my favorite game of all time. I highly recommend this to anyone willing to play it because the possibilities are endless. You can explore deep underground, adventure across grassy terrain, inspect the interesting mushroom biome, go across the dark and dangerous underworld, joyfully hop through the hallow biome, fly through the sky and space, and much more. You can even download mods using tModLoader which allows you to find even more interesting possibilities (i personally recommend calamity, very fun). Overall, this game is truly amazing as you can be as creative as you want, and you can search through the endless possibilities that this game has to offer. Terraria is a extraordinary game and you should try it.

This game is a mix of high highs and questionable lows. Beginners will definitely feel intimidated by this game, but people hyping it up as this "extremely difficult game" doesn't help. If you take your time to steadily progress it will not be difficult. That being the case, rushing through the game, which still ends up taking a while, results in a much less fulfilling experience. There's a lot of content to enjoy in this game, but the amount of time spent with a lot of it is extremely short. While the combat is fleshed out with a wide variety of weapons and equipment to use, the exploration feels less developed. Areas like the floating islands and the ocean are limited to realistically only needing a couple of visits, while the Jungle has a large portion of the game's content within. Despite the quality of content being rather inconsistent for me, I think Terraria is a game that everyone should try out. It's definitely not for everyone, and it can take a while to get into, but the low price of $10 is definitely worth it.

If you're an obsessive collector, avid quester, or thoughtful builder and architect, you will love this game.

Choose any or all of the following: Slowly proceed through tiers of armour and weapons; gradually reform and expand your house to accomodate new work areas and trophy rooms; talk and hype yourself up for facing the next boss.

If any of those sound fun to you, there's no excuse not to try this game. It goes on sale every time someone dreams of the Half-Life series.

Play alone or play with friends! Swap between them, even - all of your "characters" can jump to any Terraria world old or new!

If you want a fun game, this is it.
If you want a unique game, this is it.
If you want a game you can come back to and play again and again, this is it.
(And thats without getting into modding)
Does it have it's quirks? Of course, but what great game doesnt?
Either way, this is a game is a must if you just want to have a good time.

A retro 2d side-scroller feel with all the opportunities for awesomeness that a fully customizable sandbox environment can provide all rolled into one. Haven't played it for very long but I love it.

Edit(after an additional 2300+ hours of play): Considering my original review was made when I had been playing for a couple weeks I felt I should update this. Still an amazing game and with near unlimited replayability especially if you include the possibilities available when utilizing the online aspects. Also hard to go wrong with a game like this when considering price versus possible time spent in-game (especially when on sale and with the recent 1.3 update being released). The only complaint I have, if it can even be considered one as it has no hindrance on gameplay, is that I wish they added the achievements in a tad sooner as it felt silly having over 2300 hours in the game and none of them unlocked. Bad enough to have that much time spent on a game as is.

tl;dr - Game is still good. Game is still cheap.
